newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end mixed after favourable auction.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end mixed after favourable auction.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Swiss bonds ended the day mixed. Market demand was seen favourable for a new Swiss federal bond. March Conf futures ended lower after setting a new intraday high.
* March Conf futures ends down three at 117.65.
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 3.833 pct vs 3.87 pct.
